Package com.budgetapp.model.entity

Class Goal

java.lang.Object
com.budgetapp.model.entity.Goal
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPersistable
public class Goal extends Object implements IPersistable
Represents a financial or savings goal. Implements IPersistable to support database operations.
